decisions.note: Locator 47:106702111 is verified as JP 無我の境地. 'Cảnh giới vô ngã' is the established natural Vietnamese Buddhist/Zen expression and preserves the formal tone without relying on the Chinese bridge.
Locator 47:410051 is verified as JP 幾星霜が導く一手. 幾星霜 is a literary 'many years/seasons' expression and 一手 can be a move/step; several Vietnamese literary renderings are possible, so defer.
Locator 47:109501111 is verified as the identical JP title 無極. 'Vô cực' is the established Hán-Việt term and is compact, stable, and semantically exact.

Locator 47:108602111 is verified as the exact Latin-script JP display name Limitless Love. Preserve it unchanged instead of translating back from Chinese 无穷的爱, following the registry policy for exact Latin skill titles.
Locator 47:101701121 is verified as JP 陰りなき王道. 王道 and 陰りなき carry a regal/literary register with several plausible Vietnamese formulations; defer rather than freeze an awkward literal calque.

Locator 47:210262 is verified as JP 陽の加護. 陽 may evoke sun, sunlight, or yang/positive force depending on context, so defer until the intended nuance is reviewed rather than equating it mechanically with Chinese 日.

Locator 47:300131 is verified as JP 日本総大将. 総大将 can function as supreme commander, team general, or figurative representative; defer until the project fixes a series-consistent Vietnamese title for this role.

Locator 47:100103211 is verified as JP 日之本一のド根性. The archaic/stylized 日之本 and colloquial ド根性 are character-flavor wording; defer instead of flattening them into the Chinese 'Japan's number-one super grit'.

decisions.target_vi: Uma Musume số một Nhật Bản
decisions.note: Locator 47:202061 is verified as JP 日本一のウマ娘. The canonical registry already locks ウマ娘/赛马娘 as 'Uma Musume'; this target preserves that established series term and the unambiguous 'number one in Japan' meaning.
Locator 47:202791 is verified as JP 時中の妙. This compact classical expression concerns the subtle art of acting at the proper time; a natural canonical Vietnamese title needs register review, so defer.

decisions.source_zh_cn: 时运与否，赌在圣夜之星
decisions.note: Locator 47:910491 is independently verified as JP 運否、聖夜の星に賭ける. The poetic Christmas title admits several Vietnamese literary phrasings; defer rather than copy the Chinese wording mechanically.

Locator 47:202291 is verified as JP 明鏡止水. Although the four-character idiom is established in Japanese, Vietnamese can preserve it as Hán-Việt or render its 'clear mirror, still water' image more naturally; defer until title-register policy decides.
Locator 47:204262 is verified as JP 星の煌き. 'Ánh sao lấp lánh' is a natural, concise Vietnamese rendering of the unambiguous stellar sparkle image.

Locator 47:114101111 is confirmed by current JP game-reference listings as 星奔光天, a newly introduced four-kanji evolution title. Its coined literary reading is not safely recoverable from character-by-character translation, so defer rather than invent a Hán-Việt calque.
Locator 47:110761 is verified as JP 春光・Bon appétit. The French phrase is exact, while 春光 can be localized several poetic ways; defer until mixed-language title style is reviewed consistently.
Locator 47:107602211 is verified as JP 春めき、Lumière. The Japanese 春めき is closer to 'becoming springlike' than the Chinese expansion, and the mixed French title needs stylistic consistency; defer.

decisions.source_zh_cn: 春风吹拂 樱花漫舞
decisions.note: Locator 47:106102211 is verified as JP 春風吹きて、桜舞う. The image is clear but intentionally poetic; multiple natural Vietnamese line rhythms are possible, so defer for literary title review.

Locator 47:100781 is verified as JP 風光る, a marked Japanese spring-season expression literally involving 'shining wind'. Chinese 春风和煦 changes the image, so defer rather than canonizing that bridge interpretation.

Locator 47:200174 is verified as JP 春一番, the specific Japanese term for the first strong spring wind. A precise Vietnamese canonical treatment should preserve that meteorological/cultural sense; defer instead of translating the Chinese generic 'spring wind rises'.

Locator 47:108202211 is verified as JP 春風、蒼穹を駆ける. This is a highly literary character-flavor title; defer until a natural Vietnamese poetic rendering is reviewed rather than forcing the Chinese syntax.
